violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: observed cleaned and prepared vegetables not covered, inside the walk-in Refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Surfaces of the can opener blade were in contact with non-time/temperature control for safety food items that were observed soiled with accumulations of grime and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at any time when contamination may have occurred. Corrected during the inspection.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.Corrected during the inspection.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Medicines Relocated during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The food employee in the kitchen could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: The BEER COOLER at the bar is pooling water and has a strong odor due to thew stagnant water or solution.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Repair/ unclog the refrigeraytor and thoroughly clean the interior. Clean the exterior surfaces of the beer bottles and other beverages in this unit.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The hot water Plumbing connections under the kitchen hand washing sink, are leaking. As a result, the hot water wads found turned off from the base.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair this sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands with hot water and soap, preventing food contamination.

violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Ice scoop[ found stored directly on the top of the machine.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Place the ice scoop on an ice scoop dispenser, in a cleaned and sanitize containers , in the ice bucket, or on a cleaned and sanitized surface , after each use.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the GREASE TRAP LID/COVER is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3). Observed no supplier statement for squid and baby octopus.
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. PIC will contact the supplier to obtain the statement for squid and octopus and email to Health Department by 2/19/2025.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed surfaces of ice bins and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC will drain, clean and sanitize ice machine properly

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): chili garlic sauce in sauce bar.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. Written instruction provided by EHS.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Please train staff to wear hair restrain.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Bay leaves manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of salt and bonito flakes.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Please correct prior to the next inspection. HOT SPOT HOT POT (Inspection Date: 02/10/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: observed office no food graded containers for storing wide vermicelli, rice noodles and clear noodles in 1 DR prep cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. Please replace prior the next inspection.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: observed dirty aluminum foil on the stove. Observed mold in walking cooler shelves.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.PIC removed aluminum foil from the stove. Please clean mold in walking cooler prior the next inspection.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level is not observed at the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. Please correct prior the next inspection on 03/03/25
